notes: Open central well from -0.25L to +0.25L, narrow sole boards at -0.20 m leaving bilge visible.
Paired frames at 0.42 m nominal spacing, mast heel/step and thwarts; small fore and aft working platforms.
One tiller, light anchor, coiled rope, oars, net-rope coil, small planked fishing-tackle boxes and hand cleats.
Fishing gear is a functional reconstruction, not an archaeological inventory.
No enclosed hold, cabin, stairs, cannon or capstan; decorative floor boards do not assert continuous historical ceiling.
